title: Approvals
description: Approval requests and decisions across every workspace: waits, who decided (person, AI reviewer, rule, mode, bot), what is pending now and what expired. Read from the obs model (ADR-0046).

panels.title: Requested
panels.description: Approval requests created in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS requested FROM approval_requests_named WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS requested FROM approval_requests_named WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Pending now
panels.description: Requests waiting for a decision now, whenever they were made, whose run is still open.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS pending FROM approval_requests_named WHERE state = 'pending'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS pending FROM approval_requests_named WHERE state = 'pending'

panels.title: Decided
panels.description: Approvals decided in the time range, by anyone or anything.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS decided FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS decided FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Expired
panels.description: Approvals nobody answered within the workspace's expiry window.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS expired FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'expired' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS expired FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'expired' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Decided by a person
panels.description: Decisions made by a person, as a share of all decisions in the time range.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS human_share FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'
targets.queryText: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0) AS human_share FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}'

panels.title: Median wait for a person
panels.description: Median time from the request to a person's decision.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT median AS median_wait_ms FROM (SELECT avg(wait_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT wait_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY wait_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m
targets.queryText: SELECT median AS median_wait_ms FROM (SELECT avg(wait_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT wait_ms, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY wait_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER () AS median_n FROM (SELECT wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2)) m

panels.title: Decisions per hour by who decided
panels.description: Decisions per hour, stacked by person, reviewer, rule, mode, bot, expired, and closed with the run.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', decided_at) AS time, coalesce(decider_group, 'other') AS decider_group, count(*) AS approvals FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', decided_at) AS time, coalesce(decider_group, 'other') AS decider_group, count(*) AS approvals FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Wait for a person per hour (p50, p95)
panels.description: Percentiles of the wait of the decisions people made in each hour.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, p50, p95 FROM (SELECT time, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT time, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY wait_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', decided_at) AS time, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY time) q ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT time, p50, p95 FROM (SELECT time, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT time, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY wait_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', decided_at) AS time, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY time) q ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pending now
panels.description: Every request waiting for a decision, oldest first, with how long it has waited. A run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT created_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, risk_level, wait_mode, ((julianday('now') - julianday(created_at)) * 86400000.0) AS age_ms, run_status, run_id FROM approval_requests_named WHERE state = 'pending' AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, approval_id LIMIT 100
targets.queryText: SELECT created_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, risk_level, wait_mode, ((julianday('now') - julianday(created_at)) * 86400000.0) AS age_ms, run_status, run_id FROM approval_requests_named WHERE state = 'pending' AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, approval_id LIMIT 100

panels.title: Expired
panels.description: The newest approvals that expired unanswered. A run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT decided_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, risk_level, wait_mode, wait_ms, run_id FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'expired' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT decided_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, risk_level, wait_mode, wait_ms, run_id FROM approval_waits WHERE decider_group = 'expired' AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Workspaces
panels.description: Per workspace, the requests made in the time range by how they ended, and the median and p95 wait for a person.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT w.workspace, w.requested, w.decided, w.by_human, w.by_reviewer, w.by_rule, w.by_mode, w.by_bot, w.expired, w.closed_with_run, w.denied, w.pending, q.p50 AS human_wait_p50_ms, q.p95 AS human_wait_p95_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(workspace_id, '') AS workspace_key, max(coalesce(workspace_name, workspace_id)) AS workspace, count(*) AS requested, sum(CASE WHEN state = 'decided' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decided, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_human, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'reviewer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_reviewer, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'rule' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_rule, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'mode' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_mode, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'bot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_bot, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_with_run, sum(CASE WHEN decision = 'deny' AND decider_group <> 'expired' AND decider_group <> 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied, sum(CASE WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM approval_requests_named WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1) w LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_key, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT workspace_key, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_key ORDER BY wait_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_key) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(workspace_id, '') AS workspace_key, wait_ms FROM approval_requests_named WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY workspace_key) q ON q.workspace_key = w.workspace_key ORDER BY w.requested DESC, w.workspace
targets.queryText: SELECT w.workspace, w.requested, w.decided, w.by_human, w.by_reviewer, w.by_rule, w.by_mode, w.by_bot, w.expired, w.closed_with_run, w.denied, w.pending, q.p50 AS human_wait_p50_ms, q.p95 AS human_wait_p95_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(workspace_id, '') AS workspace_key, max(coalesce(workspace_name, workspace_id)) AS workspace, count(*) AS requested, sum(CASE WHEN state = 'decided' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decided, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_human, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'reviewer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_reviewer, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'rule' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_rule, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'mode' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_mode, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'bot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_bot, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, sum(CASE WHEN decider_group = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_with_run, sum(CASE WHEN decision = 'deny' AND decider_group <> 'expired' AND decider_group <> 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied, sum(CASE WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM approval_requests_named WHERE created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1) w LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_key, count(*) AS n, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 50 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p50, max(CASE WHEN pct_rn = (pct_n * 95 + 99) / 100 THEN wait_ms END) AS p95 FROM (SELECT workspace_key, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_key ORDER BY wait_ms) AS pct_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_key) AS pct_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(workspace_id, '') AS workspace_key, wait_ms FROM approval_requests_named WHERE decider_group = 'human' AND created_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND created_at < '${__to:date:iso}') pct_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) pct_ranked GROUP BY workspace_key) q ON q.workspace_key = w.workspace_key ORDER BY w.requested DESC, w.workspace

panels.title: By kind and decision
panels.description: Decisions grouped by kind, risk level, who decided and decision, with the median and longest wait.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT a.kind, a.risk_level, a.decider_group, a.decision, a.approvals, m.median AS median_wait_ms, a.max_wait_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(kind, '') AS kind, coalesce(risk_level, '') AS risk_level, coalesce(decider_group, '') AS decider_group, coalesce(decision, '') AS decision, count(*) AS approvals, max(wait_ms) AS max_wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision, avg(wait_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision ORDER BY wait_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision) AS median_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(kind, '') AS kind, coalesce(risk_level, '') AS risk_level, coalesce(decider_group, '') AS decider_group, coalesce(decision, '') AS decision, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision) m ON m.kind = a.kind AND m.risk_level = a.risk_level AND m.decider_group = a.decider_group AND m.decision = a.decision ORDER BY a.approvals DESC, a.kind, a.decision
targets.queryText: SELECT a.kind, a.risk_level, a.decider_group, a.decision, a.approvals, m.median AS median_wait_ms, a.max_wait_ms FROM (SELECT coalesce(kind, '') AS kind, coalesce(risk_level, '') AS risk_level, coalesce(decider_group, '') AS decider_group, coalesce(decision, '') AS decision, count(*) AS approvals, max(wait_ms) AS max_wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision, avg(wait_ms) AS median FROM (SELECT kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision, wait_ms, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision ORDER BY wait_ms) AS median_rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision) AS median_n FROM (SELECT coalesce(kind, '') AS kind, coalesce(risk_level, '') AS risk_level, coalesce(decider_group, '') AS decider_group, coalesce(decision, '') AS decision, wait_ms FROM approval_waits WHERE decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}') median_src WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL) median_ranked WHERE median_rn IN ((median_n + 1) / 2, (median_n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY kind, risk_level, decider_group, decision) m ON m.kind = a.kind AND m.risk_level = a.risk_level AND m.decider_group = a.decider_group AND m.decision = a.decision ORDER BY a.approvals DESC, a.kind, a.decision

panels.title: Longest waits
panels.description: The decisions that waited longest. A run id opens the run view.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT decided_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, decider_group, decision, decided_by, wait_ms, run_id FROM approval_waits WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY wait_ms DESC, decided_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT decided_at, workspace_name, bot_name, kind, tool_name, decider_group, decision, decided_by, wait_ms, run_id FROM approval_waits WHERE wait_ms IS NOT NULL AND decided_at >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND decided_at < '${__to:date:iso}' ORDER BY wait_ms DESC, decided_at DESC LIMIT 50
